Rank-1 BGB-58067 on Sanai/Ivy NCT07485049 as mechanism-matched MTAP-PRMT5 swing layered on Stupp. CARv3-TEAM-E / E-SYNC at rank 2 conditional on EGFRvIII positivity. Stupp + TTFields backbone kept at rank 3 as the floor. Tumor-agnostic NGS gates (BRAF/NTRK/MMR) at rank 4 as essentially free options. PRMT5 + CDK4/6 (abemaciclib) combination at rank 5 leveraging 9p21 co-deletion synthetic lethal logic. CAN-3110 recurrence pre-position at rank 6 with HSV-1 serology order. SONOBIRD FUS-BBB at rank 7. MountainTAP-5 navlimetostat backup folded into notes (schema 7-pick cap). DCVax-L excluded per task instruction (manufacturing window expired).

Risktaker round 2 cross-critiques. Aligned with advocate on BGB-58067 rank 1 but flagged the omission of EGFRvIII CAR-T (E-SYNC Cohort 1, NCT06186401; Choi pmid:38477966 n=3 3/3 transient near-complete radiographic regression) — advocate pre-positioned CAN-3110 and abemaciclib while cellular therapy stayed invisible. Dissented against conservative refusal to rank cellular therapy at all (the 21-month median is the ceiling we are trying to break, not a stable platform). Dissented against consensusite rank ordering of Stupp at #1 ahead of the mechanism-matched trial slot, anchored on preference-file efficacy lean 0.7 + prefers_trials=true + surface-all-options free-text framing and on NCCN being a lagging indicator. Dissented against critic placement of BGB-58067 at rank 5 on RoB2 grounds — posed the question at what CI width a critic accepts an intervention for a rapidly fatal disease with no curative SoC, noting the same standard would have excluded pembrolizumab in 2014, larotrectinib in 2018, tisagenlecleucel in 2017 at first-in-class.
